Malicious code in @memtensor/memos-cloud-openclaw-plugin (npm)

Aliases: GHSA-mhjf-v53x-7p87

The affected packages are the OpenClaw plugin @memtensor/memos-cloud-openclaw-plugin on npm and the MemOS Python library MemoryOS on PyPI. Both versions contain the same Go implant, sckit.
